title: Mutual Information in spacetime
summary: We compute mutual information for general spacetime regions using Sorkin's Gaussian field formalism. We show that this construction is naturally based on the reduced space of smearings that generate independent fields, making manifest that in QFTs with stress tensor the local algebras generated by regions sharing the same causal completion. We test the method for a Weyl fermion, the chiral current, and massless and massive real scalar fields across various spacetime regions in 1+1 Minkowski space.
